10k.note: 10-K describes Merit Medical Systems as a manufacturer and marketer of single-use medical devices for interventional cardiology, radiology, oncology, and endoscopy procedures (Cardiovascular and Endoscopy segments). Product portfolio is FDA-cleared / CE-marked commercial devices; no investigational drug pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public drug-pipeline page — Merit Medical is a commercial medical-device company; corporate site lists marketed product families (access, angiography, embolization, drainage, biopsy, etc.), not P1/P2/P3 drug clinical trials.

ctgov.note: Both interventional P1-3 trials returned are TERMINATED and therefore excluded: NCT01387932 (HepaSphere/QuadraSphere doxorubicin-eluting microspheres in HCC, lead sponsor Merit Medical, PHASE3 TERMINATED) and NCT03960008 (SBRT vs TACE bridge-to-transplant, lead sponsor Lahey Clinic with Merit as collaborator, PHASE3 TERMINATED).

commercial_product.note: Merit Medical revenue derives from FDA-cleared / CE-marked commercial single-use medical devices; no proprietary clinical-stage drug under active P1/P2/P3 development.
marketed_franchises: Cardiovascular: peripheral intervention, cardiac intervention, custom procedural solutions, OEM
Embolotherapy / interventional oncology (e.g., HepaSphere/QuadraSphere microspheres, EmboCube, Embosphere)

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Trial terminated; per workflow rule, terminated/withdrawn studies are excluded from active P1/P2/P3 pipeline.

excluded_partner_owned.asset: SBRT vs TACE bridge-to-transplant in HCC
excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated study with Lahey Clinic as lead sponsor; Merit Medical is only a collaborator. Also TERMINATED.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medtech / device company — no active proprietary drug or device clinical pipeline. Merit Medical develops and markets FDA-cleared single-use interventional medical devices; the only Merit-sponsored P1/P2/P3 trial in the public registry (NCT01387932, HepaSphere DEB-TACE in HCC) was terminated, and the only collaborator-listed trial (NCT03960008) is investigator-initiated and also terminated.
